name: exile-build-companion-monorepo
description: Path of Exile Companion HUD monorepo (game-data, core engine, Cloudflare Worker/DO relay, OLED PWA, Tauri v2 tray host)

scripts.build:all: pnpm --filter @exile-hud/core build && pnpm --filter @exile-hud/pwa build && pnpm --filter @exile-hud/desktop build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @exile-hud/core test && pnpm --filter @exile-hud/edge-worker test && pnpm --filter @exile-hud/pwa test
